title: What's New: Manufacturing Analytics (New and Updated Reports) (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Vision and Strategy for Manufacturing Analytics
Production Order VIP Demo and Updated Reports Summary

features.name: Updated Manufacturing Reports
features.description: Complete makeover of manufacturing reports in version 26.2 with modernized layouts. Reports now include Word layouts for printing and Excel layouts for analytical capabilities.

features.name: Production Order VIP Report
features.description: Updated report with multiple layout options including obsoleted, Word, and Excel layouts. Supports both print and analysis modes with slicers for data filtering.
caveats: Obsoleted layout still available for backward compatibility

features.name: Production Cost Shares Report
features.description: New Excel report replacing four legacy reports: bomb cost share distribution, rolled up cost shares, detail calculation, and quantity explosion. Includes multiple worksheets for different analysis types and personas.
caveats: Multiple worksheet types: single level, exploded, rolled up

features.name: Work/Machine Center Load Report
features.description: New Excel report replacing legacy work center load and machine sender load reports. Includes printable and analysis worksheets for capacity planning.
caveats: Two printable and two analysis worksheets

features.name: Manufacturing Analytics Landing Page
features.description: Central documentation hub for manufacturing analytics covering PowerBI app, reports, and other data viewing options organized by persona.

features.name: Legacy Report Deprecation
features.description: Seven legacy manufacturing reports are being deprecated and will be removed in a later version. Reports have been marked as obsolete in documentation.
features.status_evidence_quote: these 711 reports are going away in a and will will be removed in a later version
caveats: Documentation will be updated with removal timeline

features.name: Excel and Word Report Layouts
features.description: New layout options for manufacturing reports. Word layouts designed for printing, Excel layouts for analytical capabilities with slicers and pivot features. Both include printable worksheets.
caveats: Excel layouts include dedicated printable worksheets
